## MC Hoster 1.4.0

### New: Dark Teams (made by DarkerDawnFR, tick it in tab 5)
DonutSMP-style teams.
- `/team` opens your team menu: members (online or not), team home, team chat, friendly fire, leave/disband.
- `/team create <name>`, `/team invite <player>`, `/team join <team>`, `/team leave`, `/team kick <player>`, `/team transfer <player>`, `/team disband`.
- `/team sethome` and `/team home` (5-second countdown, not in combat).
- Team chat: `/tc <message>`, or `/team chat` to switch all your chat to the team (start a message with `!` to talk to everyone). Muted players can't use it.
- No friendly fire by default; the owner switches it with `/team pvp`.
- `/team top` shows the biggest teams. Up to 10 players per team (change `max-members`).
- `{team}` and `{team_online}` on Dark Scoreboard (a Team line is in the default scoreboard), and `{team}` in Dark Chat's chat format.
